title: Two Sum
statement: Return the indices of two different elements whose values add to target. Exactly one answer exists.
constraints: Input: nums: list[int], target: int · Return: list[int]

title: Valid Parentheses
statement: Return True if every opening bracket is closed by the same type in the correct order.

title: Binary Search
statement: Return the index of target in a sorted list, or -1 if it is absent.
constraints: Input: sorted nums: list[int], target: int · Return: int

title: Maximum Subarray
statement: Return the largest sum of any non-empty contiguous subarray.
constraints: Input: non-empty nums: list[int] · Return: int

title: Contains Duplicate
statement: Return True when any value appears at least twice, otherwise False.

title: Reverse String
statement: Reverse the input list of characters in place and return the same list.

title: Fizz Buzz
statement: For numbers 1 through n, return FizzBuzz for multiples of both 3 and 5, Fizz for 3, Buzz for 5, otherwise the number as text.
constraints: Input: n: int, n >= 1 · Return: list[str]

title: Merge Sorted Arrays
statement: Return one sorted list containing all values from two already sorted lists.
constraints: Input: a, b: list[int] · Return: list[int]

title: Climbing Stairs
statement: You may climb one or two steps at a time. Return the number of distinct ways to reach step n.
constraints: Input: n: int, n >= 1 · Return: int

title: First Unique Character
statement: Return the index of the first character that occurs exactly once, or -1 when no such character exists.
